ordinary_english_and_cfel: Ordinary prose uses of “term” and CFEL operator grammar references are excluded; only typed Term// Subjects, exact Term Definition form Subjects, and exact Atom-ID mentions count.

retirement_groups.name: Term Definition Method atoms
retirement_groups.note: Eight active Method atoms, each defines a lexical Term// instance.

retirement_groups.name: Requirement Term Definition atom
retirement_groups.note: Distinct from the eight Method atoms; active Subject uses legacy Term address.

retirement_groups.name: Term kind and property declarations
retirement_groups.note: Direct kind and Term.Name property declarations; handle after inbound Subjects and protected CCE naming are resolved.

retirement_groups.name: Term registration and form-consumer sources
retirement_groups.note: Exact direct refs are enumerated in typed Subject groups and form_registration_and_semantics_sources; includes subject grammar, Terms Graph and form consumers.

retirement_groups.name: Preserve CCE naming and Declaration Semantics
retirement_groups.note: Per latest human boundary. These overlap direct Term semantics; CA-R-2276 explicitly requires reusable Terms for one-to-one names.

minimal_safe_retirement_order_if_confirm: 1. Confirm scope and reconcile removal of Terms with CA-R-2276, which requires reusable Terms for CCE one-to-one names.
2. Preserve CCE naming and Declaration Semantics; mark exact mixed-clause boundaries before editing consumers.
3. Resolve direct typed Subjects and exact Atom-ID refs to Term Definition form/registration consumers; retire only explicitly authorized Term-specific clauses.
4. Retire the eight Method Term Definition atoms and separate Requirement Term Definition atom only if both are in confirmed scope.
5. Retire Term and Term.Name declarations after all inbound refs are resolved; keep archived, Draft, release and applicable copies untouched.

preservation_conflict.finding: Current CA-R-2276 is titled “require one-to-one canonical entity names with reusable terms”. Keeping this naming rule unchanged while removing the Term branch is a direct conflict; a human decision or approved clause rewrite is needed before retirement.

term_definition_form_authority.interpretation: The exact Method form selector occurs in current Subjects and active Method atom metadata. The inventory found no active Requirement Declaration whose active Subject is exactly that form selector; this is a discovery, not a claim that the form is unauthorized.
